newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas holds over 50 pct of Cie Bancaire.
newsitem.headline: Paribas holds over 50 pct of Cie Bancaire.

text.p: Groupe Paribas said on Tuesday that it had boosted its share of equity and voting rights in Cie Bancaire to over 50 percent.
Paribas now controls 50.28 percent of the capital and 50.01 percent of the voting rights of Cie Bancaire, French financial markets supervisor CMF said in a statement.

"Following the acquisition of Compagnie Bancaire shares on the stockmarket and the decision to take dividends on "stock" dividend, Compagnie Financiere de Paribas has taken its share in both equity and voting rights of Compagnie Bancaire above 50 percent," Paribas said in a statement.
Paribas has been the major shareholder of Cie Bancaire since 1979 and until recently held 47 percent of the capital.

It said the boost in control reflected its confidence in the future of Cie Bancaire, whose main activity is specialised financial services. It said the move also consolidated Bancaire's position as one of the two core businesses of Groupe Paribas. The other is international investment banking.
